# Future implementation tasks

## Creation boundary

This Change was created as a documentation-only delivery. Every product task below is intentionally unchecked. Structural readiness is not permission to begin implementation in the creation session. No product build, Automation, benchmark, trace or repair is claimed.

Read design.md and attachments/INDEX.md before the first ready task. All paths are relative to the selected workspace. Preserve unrelated changes, including the pre-existing Bind_FName.cpp edit. The source inventory task column is the migration boundary; companion-file globs are restricted to the listed registration owners, never permission for unrelated edits.

## Execution and verification setup

All new C++ cases live in Plugins/Angelscript/Source/AngelscriptTest/NewVersion and use the public Angelscript.UnitTest identity. Test classes must expose the literal task selectors below; a selector discovering zero/incomplete cases is failure. Each behavior card keeps grouped RED, implementation and grouped GREEN. Missing interfaces follow the TDD skill's bounded compile-evidence rules; mechanical moves and unchanged-behavior measurements do not require fabricated RED.

In the selected PowerShell 7 process:

```powershell
Import-Module ./.agents/skills/harness/scripts/Harness.psd1
$context = New-HarnessContext -WorkspaceRoot (Get-Location).Path
```

Before Automation after any C++/header/Build.cs edit, freeze source writers and successfully run `Invoke-Harness -Command ue.build -Context $context -Parameters @{ TimeoutMs = 1800000 }`. The proving selector below consumes that exact binary. Check the Harness exit/status and the enforced Automation report, not only the shell process exit. Shared runs may satisfy several selectors only with task-specific discovered/executed case mapping and exact source/binary identity. UE builds/tests retain their exclusive workspace lease; Ready tasks are not automatically safe concurrent source writers when Files overlap.

For product tasks, every card's Cases must execute through its proving selection and satisfy the stated outputs; missing/incomplete discovery or a missing report is failure. File moves and final spec handoff do not require fabricated behavioral RED. Task 6.4 is document-only and does not require a new UE build. Family migration cards below use new test classes under their literal Migration prefix: adapt inspected inputs/oracles into those classes or shared RuntimeBindingTestSupport.h helpers; merely pointing at an existing case under another prefix does not include it in the run. Translation-unit-local fixtures are references to adapt, not public helper APIs. Existing host-only or operations-only checks remain controls and cannot substitute for required bound/VM execution. Task 1.1 owns the independent baseline-expectations.json handoff; later family cards consume its expected semantic surface and disposition rules rather than copying a migrated manifest.

Task evidence is appended to the owning card after execution; listed verification/data attachments are created only when their results exist and indexed in the same edit. Standard verification and archival policy applies after the implementation DAG completes. The creation report is attachments/data/planning-validation.md, not evidence of any task below.
